dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? I thought Basima would be here...

dialogues.speaker: Mayskaya
dialogues.text: Basima is designing new Finchballs and can't come in person for the time being, so I'm managing the stall in her place.

dialogues.speaker: Mayskaya
dialogues.text: ...Please forgive me if my expression makes you uneasy. I'm not upset, nor am I in a bad mood. I have simply... grown used to not showing any expression.

dialogues.speaker: Mayskaya
dialogues.text: I tried forcing myself to smile, but it seemed to startle Shatskaya when she came to play Bing-Bang Finchball.

dialogues.speaker: Mayskaya
dialogues.text: After that, I thought it would be better to remain expressionless...

dialogues.speaker: Mayskaya
dialogues.text: Basima told me that I smile very naturally when I pet finches, but I have never noticed it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Mayskaya
dialogues.text: Still, when touching creatures as adorable as finches, it is only natural to smile. Should the opportunity arise, please spend more time with finches as well.

dialogues.speaker: Mayskaya
dialogues.text: After all, finches are the cutest.
